attackers_goals: Impair the ability of the cloud environment to recover in disaster scenarios.
description: A Soft Delete configuration was disabled on a cloud storage account. Soft delete allows a deletion of a blob or a container to be restored. Disabling it will impair the ability of the cloud environment to recover in disaster scenarios.
detector_tags: Cloud Data Asset Disaster Recovery Risks, Cloud Data Asset Protection Tampering, Cloud Data Asset Configuration, Data Detection & Response
investigative_actions: Check if the identity intended to disable soft delete for this storage account. Check if the identity performed additional malicious operations in the cloud environment.
name: Soft delete of cloud storage configuration was disabled
